relations.relation: identify the target learners' stated or implied experience level and prerequisite knowledge the exercise assumes
verify the exercise's problem statement, worked solution, and answer key are technically and factually accurate
assess whether accompanying explanations justify each solution step and address likely points of confusion
determine whether plausible incorrect answers or approaches to the exercise map to distinct, identifiable misconceptions
compare the skills and difficulty the exercise requires against the identified target learner experience level
exercise's correct answer and solution steps attested as factually and computationally accurate
accompanying explanation cited as sufficient to justify each solution step
exercise separates learners by mastery level (diagnostic discrimination across responses)
exercise's required prerequisites and difficulty matched against the stated learner experience tier
derived complexity score compared against target-level threshold to flag over/under-calibration
specify the reference learner population and prerequisite baseline against which exercise appropriateness is judged
ground each exercise's stated answer/procedure against a verified solution to establish accuracy
compare the exercise's explanation against a clarity/completeness criterion to derive a well-explained determination
assess whether exercise's incorrect options or failure modes reveal specific, distinguishable learner misconceptions
compare exercise difficulty and required prerequisites against the individuated target learner level to derive a fit determination

metric.name: Exercise design quality
metric.text: Exercises are accurate, well‑explained, diagnostically informative, and appropriate to the target learners’ experience level.
